values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, online or 1-800-456-2267. 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds. Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident and the 2-night pre-season reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), phone, no electric, 2027 opening May 14. NEW: season close 09-05 (Labor Day), 9-month window and 14-night max (were inherited), 45 sites to 40 ft (was 52 to 30, derived), showers, dump, water spigots. Note: dropped site/length/hookup/booking restatements, the wrong '~45 pull-throughs' (RA lists 1), and the MINIMUM STAY line (booking.min_stay holds it).
flags: Season note (manual, 2026-10-20) says 'Reservable through Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend); DEC posts no later date.' DEC's 2026 summary does post a close: 'Beaverkill ... May 15 ... Sept 7' (Labor Day 2026). Suggest: 'Closes on Labor Day: Sep 7 in 2026 (DEC summary), Sep 5 in 2027 (ReserveAmerica).'

Name: ReserveAmerica publishes the campground as 'Beaverkill (John and Patricia Adams Campground at)', i.e. 'John and Patricia Adams Campground at Beaverkill'; DEC's 2026 summary still says 'Beaverkill'. Consider the published name.
Weak waterfront lead: ReserveAmerica tags every campsite 'Near Water - no' while the entry is riverfront; RA does this at every DEC campground checked.
